text: My office has received several requests from residents of Dundonald Street inquiring about the status of the project at 587-599 Yonge Street. Residents who have endured several years of construction and have been displaced from their on-street parking are anxious for conditions to be returned to the pre-construction conditions.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services to immediately return Dundonald Street and Gloucester Street to pre-construction traffic and parking regulations now that the construction staging permits are set to expire on May 31, 2021 and the project is complete at 587-599 Yonge Street.
